steps: Open the Chime app and go to Settings (gear icon) > Refer Friends to get your referral link: https://help.chime.com/what-is-chimes-standard-referral-program-eca42e30
Send the link to a friend who does not already have Chime — they must sign up through your link.
Your friend receives a qualifying direct deposit of $200 or more within 45 days of opening the account (payroll or benefits; personal transfers and crypto do not count).
Your friend activates their physical Chime card within 14 days of the qualifying direct deposit.
Bonuses are typically posted within 10 business days after all requirements are met — your friend gets $100; your bonus matches the offer shown when you referred.
You can earn up to 10 successful referral rewards per calendar year.
